finding: F-53-or-next-free: bit-exact SAMPLE.MID -> SAMPLE.DWM re-encode attempt validating the F-53 grammar
encoder: results/format-re/diamondware-census/dwm_encode_v2.py (first public MIDI->DWM encoder; prior art none per F-50)

match.header: 92/96 bytes exact; only body-size (0x18) and event-count (0x1C) differ, because the stream diverges later (12416/2550 vs 12686/2613)
match.body: byte-exact from body byte 0 through 517 (99 consecutive records), first divergence at body byte 518
match.drums: 659/659 drum onsets exact (voice, vol, pitch word)

rules_derived.quantizer: hb = (9*tick + 24)//50 = round-half-DOWN(tick*0.18); proven by 8 onsets at fractional exactly 0.5 all rounding down (e.g. 2200.5 -> 2200) while 908 match nearest; drums 659/659
rules_derived.note_off: off record at hb(off_tick) - 1 (916/916 ground truth)
rules_derived.voice_release: voice busy through hb(off_tick) + 1 (proven at hb 599: off record 598 but v0 not reused at 599)
allocator_tiers: channel's last voice if free and patch-matching
lowest free voice with matching patch
lowest free voice with any patch (emit [03][p][v] first, before the note-on)
none free -> drop the note (no record)
rules_derived.same_heartbeat_order: drum records before melodic records at equal heartbeat; melodic patch record before its note-on; stream strictly time-ordered, no end-of-song marker
rules_derived.patch_table: [drum patch 21 31 4f 00 f2 d2 52 73 00 00 06 (internal default, not an IBK slot)][IBK slot 18][38][80]; melodic channels sorted ascending; patch index = table position
rules_derived.header: magic 18B + unknown constant 6B 00 1a 58 a9 f6 b2 + u32 body_size + u32 event_count + u32 52 (patch offset) + u32 96 (body offset) + u16 720 (rate deciHz) + u16 patch_count + u16 1 + u16 0x0100 + u32 6 (melodic voices) + 4x11B patches

drops.note: all 18 true drops are MIDI ch1/ch2; 3 true drops occur with a patch-matching time-free voice in the model, so the converter's busy-state diverges around dropped-note cascades (voice-centric off-release vs instance FIFO)

divergences.cascade_effect: every dropped/mis-voiced note shifts the strictly time-ordered stream; byte equality ends at first divergence (record 99, body byte 518)
divergences.open: exact release/tie-break tail of the allocator (per-channel rotation memory or off-instance pairing suspected)

significance: confirms the F-53 grammar is complete and correct as an encoding spec; the remaining gap is one algorithmic component (allocator tail), not any unknown record type, field, or transform
prior_art: none public (F-40/F-41/F-46/F-50 verified); dwm_encode_v2.py is the first working MIDI->DWM encoder
